events.title: Ben Lee & Georgia Maq (AUS)
events.description: You would be hard-pressed to find two more inspiring, outspoken and provocative figures in Australian music than Ben Lee and Georgia Maq. Both charting their own unique paths in an industry that too often rewards conformity and predictability, they have formed a deep bond over the years as friends, collaborators, rabble rousers and mutual enablers. Now, for the first time, this September and October, they join forces for The “Two Most Annoying People You Love” Tour. The tour will take them...

events.title: Kate Miller-Heidke (AUS)
events.description: Join genre-defying singer-songwriter Kate Miller-Heidke as she launches her new album, and explores territory at once both ancient and new - deconstructing our past, illuminating the present, and casting her eye towards our future, on her new gothic folk masterpiece, THE KISS AND THE ABYSS. On her new album, Kate Miller-Heidke returns to her musical roots - while pushing further into the unknown than ever before. A striking fusion of gothic folk, theatrical storytelling, cinematic...

events.title: Chris Connor: Viva Elvis (UK)
events.description: Following a sold-out 2025 tour, internationally acclaimed Elvis tribute artist Chris Connor returns to Australia for his major 2026 tour 'VIVA ELVIS'. From the producers of the 2026 SOLD OUT SMASH HIT 'DEAN Z SHOW', we bring you another EPIC SHOW!  Widely regarded as one of the most authentic and electrifying Elvis performers in the world today, Chris Connor has captivated audiences across the globe with his unmatched energy, vocal precision, and striking resemblance to The King...

events.title: ABBA: Thank You For The Music (AUS)
events.description: Get ready to relive the magic of ABBA in a two-hour live concert spectacular! ABBA: Thank You For The Music takes you on a glittering journey through the songs, stories, and sparkle that made ABBA one of the world’s most iconic bands. Sing along to all the timeless hits — Waterloo, Mamma Mia, Dancing Queen, SOS, Ring Ring and so many more - performed by Narelle Ryan, Michelle Birmingham, and a sensational full backing band.
